title: Existence of an ample line bundle descends from an arbitrary field extension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof first recovers quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness from the extended scheme. It descends the line bundle and its ampleness to a finite-type ground-field algebra, specializes to a finite residue extension and applies finite locally free ample descent.
